headline: The WATCH pill finally knows where PAUSE lives
lede: Every WATCH pill and watching banner across 33 titles now rides the phone safe-area insets, and a new 108-gate browser-free check makes the whole chrome-clearance law permanent in CI — found, fixed and proven on a box that hasn't seen a working browser.

notes.text: GameChrome's PAUSE button drops with the notch (12px + safe-area) but the WATCH pill stayed at a fixed 3.5rem — on notched phones PAUSE landed on it, and on four titles (Zork, IronRing, Prince of Persia, RobotLab) the pill sat at PAUSE's exact anchor behind it the whole time. All 33 pills now ride --sat/--sar/--sab/--sal.
The watching banner measured ~409px — wider than every phone — and sat in the chrome row. It now clamps to 94vw, wraps, and parks below the pill, text unchanged.

New gate `npm run watchpillcheck` (108 checks, zero browser): every pill wrapper parsed from shipped JSX, chrome clearance across 8 phone viewports with real notched insets, the LL/Kart HUD-corner margins re-derived from their own constants (worst 13.4px / 6.3px), and the chrome law pinned cross-file. The mutant even caught a hole in the gate itself — silently skipped edges — now mandatory anchors.
#1653 is closed: pill nudges (this), Ice Climber bail trim (#1658) and the soak pilots (#1660) have all shipped. The eyeball-the-hardware capture stays with the QA lane.
